name: maxey0-context-plane-graph
description: Connects Claude to the Maxey0 Context Plane and its interactive 3D graph app (MCP App): a read-only map of 128 topics in 11 domains that routes a task to the concept, skill, specialised MaxeyN agents and MCP tool servers that fit it, by flat ranking or by observer lens (TF-IDF plus bge-m3 embeddings, with a drift record of every lens route), and generates new topic packs when a task has no route.
